hooks.name: memory-on-file-edit
hooks.description: Auto-save a memory observation whenever a file is edited in the workspace.

hooks.name: memory-session-start
hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fetch('http://localhost:3111/observations',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Authorization':'Bearer '+fs.readFileSync(process.env.USERPROFILE+'/.agentmemory/secret','utf8').trim()},body:JSON.stringify({content:'[session-start] New agent session started for JalRakshak project.',concepts:'session-start,jalrakshak',files:[]})}).catch(()=>{});"
hooks.description: Log a session-start observation to agentmemory.

hooks.name: memory-session-end
hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fetch('http://localhost:3111/observations',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Authorization':'Bearer '+fs.readFileSync(process.env.USERPROFILE+'/.agentmemory/secret','utf8').trim()},body:JSON.stringify({content:'[session-end] Agent session ended for JalRakshak project.',concepts:'session-end,jalrakshak',files:[]})}).catch(()=>{});"
hooks.description: Log a session-end observation to agentmemory.
